sections.shortTitle: Barret Hodgson International University at Karachi Amendment Act 2016
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IX OF 2018
ACT IX OF 2018
BARRET HODGSON INTERNATIONAL UNIVERSITY AT KARACHI
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2016
An Act to amend the Barrett Hodgson International University
at Karachi Act, 2015 (Sindh Act No. XL)
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 11th April, 2018]
No.PAS/LEGIS-PB-07/2016,
dated 11.4.2018.---The Barret
Hodgson International University at Karachi (Amendment) Bill, 2016 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 16th January, 2018 and assented
to by the Governor of Sindh on 12th February, 2018 is hereby published as an
Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Barrett
Hodgson International University Act, 2015, in the manner hereinafter
appearing.
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Barrett Hodgson International University at Karachi
(Amendment), Act, 2016.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 16th January, 2018 and assented
to by the Governor of Sindh on 12th February, 2018 is hereby published as an
Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Barrett
Hodgson International University Act, 2015, in the manner hereinafter
appearing.
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
. 4. Board of Governors.---Section 17(1) to be substituted as under:
Section
17(1). The Board shall consist of a Chairperson and Members as under:
(a) Dr.
M.S Habib-whose name appears in the Preamble, shall be the life time
Chairperson, however in case of his demise or he is incapacitated to perform
his duties, the Board shall elect its nominee.
(b) The
Chancellor
(c) The
Vice Chancellor
(d) A
serving or retired Judge of the High Court to be appointed/nominated by the
Chief Justice, High Court of Sindh.
(e) A
nominee of the Higher Education Commission.
(f) Secretary
to the Government of Sindh, Education Department or his nominees.
(g) Two
persons of outstanding merit to be nominated by the Foundation and two members
of the Provincial Assembly to be nominated by the Speaker.
(h) Five
persons of eminence representing various disciplines and professions, nominated
by the Chancellor in consultation with the Vice Chancellor.
